[b]Official Diplomatic Request from the Government of Etherniasti[/b]

To: The Esteemed Government of [nation]United Hydronia[/nation]
Subject: Proposal for Mutual Visa-Free Access Agreement
Date: March 16, 2025

On behalf of the Government of Etherniasti and under the leadership of Reginold III, we extend our warmest regards to the people and government of United Hydronia. As long-standing partners in trade and regional cooperation, Etherniasti formally proposes the establishment of mutual visa-free travel between our two nations.

We believe this agreement will serve the best interests of both our countries by fostering stronger diplomatic, economic, and cultural ties. The implementation of a visa-free arrangement will provide the following key benefits:

Five Key Benefits of Visa-Free Travel Between Etherniasti and United Hydronia

[b]1. Boosting Trade & Economic Growth
[/b]
Visa-free travel will facilitate easier business exchanges, allowing entrepreneurs, investors, and professionals to expand trade partnerships and strengthen economic ties between our nations.

[b]2. Enhancing Tourism & Cultural Exchange[/b]

Encouraging citizens to travel freely will boost tourism revenue, promote cultural understanding, and allow both nations to share their unique traditions, landscapes, and historical sites.

3. Strengthening Diplomatic Relations

The agreement will reinforce trust and cooperation between our governments, demonstrating our commitment to shared prosperity, regional stability, and mutual support in international matters.

4. Improving Workforce Mobility

A visa-free policy will enable skilled workers, researchers, and students to access opportunities more easily, supporting the exchange of knowledge, innovation, and expertise in critical industries.

5. Simplifying Travel for Families & Citizens

Many citizens of both nations have family, friends, and business partners across our borders. This agreement will make travel more convenient, reducing bureaucratic hurdles and strengthening personal connections.

Next Steps

The Government of Etherniasti proposes a diplomatic meeting to discuss the details and implementation of this agreement. We are open to exploring any necessary legal and security frameworks to ensure the smooth operation of this initiative.

We look forward to your positive response and to working together to bring this agreement to fruition for the benefit of both Etherniasti and United Hydronia.

With respect and anticipation,
Alaric Trevayne
Minister of Foreign Affairs
Government of Etherniasti
